name: abx
description: Use the ABX CLI (abx) to plan, launch, host, inspect, and operate ABX NFT projects on supported networks: static 1/1s, image series, editions, JavaScript/code drops, and Solidity-rendered projects. Covers on-chain and off-chain content, managed or self-hosted resolvers, storage, minting and sales, PostParams, hooks, custom minters, migrations, feedback, locks, and capability questions. Requires Node 22.13+ and @artblocks/abx-cli
